parameters.value: Power lawn mower is an equipment that operates with electric motor /engine for efficient grass cutting of large areas and professional landscaping

A robust deck housing rotating blades, powered by a gasoline/electric engine for self-propulsion and cutting action. The frame supports handlebars for guidance, wheels or rollers for movement, and adjustable features like cutting height, with durable components.
Walk Behind Lawn Mowers, Stand-on Lawn Mowers Or higher
Single Speed, Variable Speed Or higher
Cast Aluminium, Stamped / Pressed Steel, Composite Polymer, ABS, Aluminium Skeleton with Polymer Cover & Underdeck
Upto 300, Upto 450, Upto 600, Upto 750, Upto 900, Upto 1050, Upto 1200
The installation and demonstration of the machine at the consignee place shall be carried out as part of installation and commissioning with suitable sample preparation
1 year from the date of satisfactory commissioning of the machine
Agree to provide all supports and spares etc including CMC / AMC as per independent contract if placed by the buyer for 7 years from the date of commissioning
